observation.command: cat /etc/apt/sources.list 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | head; echo "=== arch ==="; dpkg --print-architecture; echo "=== check curl/ssl ==="; which ca-certificates 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/share/ca-certificates/ 2>/dev/null | head -3
